name: generate3DesKey
description: Returns a Base64-encoded key for the Triple DES (`DESede`) algorithm, built from a seed string. The result is the same as `toBase64(string)`, so the seed must be 16 or 24 bytes long to give a valid key; other lengths fail in `encrypt()` with "Wrong key size". Use `generateSecretKey("DESede")` for a random key.

params.name: string
params.description: The seed string used to build the key. Lucee does not accept `string` as a named argument; it uses `input`.

coldfusion.notes: Undocumented until CF11 and missing from getFunctionList() until CF2021, but present since CF7.

examples.title: Generate a key from a 24 character seed
